controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Schenk and McKinnon (2024) controlled mosaic. Original 100 m grid delivered at about 197 m per equatorial texel. Source resolution and photographed shadows vary; globe Shadows add approximate lighting. Gray grid marks source no-data.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the 256.2 × 251.4 × 248.6 km reference ellipsoid. Colors saturate below −1 and above +1 km. Brightness shows relief under fixed northwest light, without height exaggeration. Gray grid marks missing model values. The 200 m grid contains stereogrammetric and photogrammetric terrain estimates; effective detail varies.
